Loss report: gitea -> argo
[lost] pipeline/ci/job/build job.runner (Argo schedules pods; only a platform label can carry a node selector)
[lost] pipeline/ci/trigger/0 ext.passthrough (Ext of provider gha (inputs) is not written to the Argo file; it is kept in round-trip metadata)
[external] pipeline/ci/trigger/0 trigger.manual: argo submit --from workflowtemplate/ci (start a run with: argo submit --from workflowtemplate/ci; the Workflow object needs a ServiceAccount with the rights in .argo/rbac/)
[emulated] pipeline/ci pipeline.inputs: string parameter (input environment has type choice, which Argo parameters lack; it is a string parameter and the type stays in the marker; input dry-run has type boolean, which Argo parameters lack; it is a string parameter and the type stays in the marker)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/build/step/build-step-1 step.shell: container command sh with a bash-if-present wrapper (the source runs the step under bash when the image has it; the container runs bash -e when the image has bash, else sh -e, so bash-only syntax fails under sh)
